breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still combines both conflicting instructions, stating 'automatic Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid with a half shift and gamma centering' for multiple steps. The ground truth resolves the conflict by specifying only a gamma-centered k-point grid, dropping the half-shift entirely. The agent failed to remove the half-shift instruction and instead kept both contradictory settings.
